utility.name: Hackerbot Web Client
utility.author: Z. Cliffe Schreuders
utility.description: Installs a minimal browser-based IRC client, served over HTTP (typically from the hackerbot server itself), that connects directly to a private message conversation with hackerbot over ergochat's built-in WebSocket listener. The client's IRC nick is set to the local user's username, and it sends "hello" to the bot automatically as soon as it connects, so the hackerbot conversation starts without the user having to know any IRC commands. The chat history is kept in the browser and in a log on the server (/var/lib/hackerbot_webclient/history.jsonl), and the two are merged when the page loads. Messages show their time by default. Client commands (never sent to the bot): /clear blanks the chat window (for clean screenshots) without deleting the history; /flags lists the flags the bot has sent to this browser (only ones it received itself, not ones merged in from the server log); /timestamps shows or hides message times; /help lists these commands.
